emails.body: Hi Ana, please find attached our detention invoice for container MSKU1234567. The container was delivered to your Antwerp DC on 2026-09-16 and collected as an empty on 2026-09-29. Free time at the DC ended on 2026-09-18, so we charge 11 days (19 to 29 September) at EUR 150 per day. Payment term is 30 days, so the due date is 2026-11-07. Sofie, I put you in copy because the container was at your site. If you need the terminal gate tickets to check the dates, just let me know.

emails.body: Sofie, INV-48213 from Nordline (EUR 1,650 detention on MSKU1234567) landed in my queue. 11 days at the Antwerp DC looks long to me. I have put a payment block on it in MIR4 for now. Can you tell me when unloading was finished and when the empty was actually collected? If we want to dispute this, I need your answer by 2026-10-16 at the latest, so we stay well before the due date of 2026-11-07.

Ana, I went through the gate log and our mails. Unloading was finished on 2026-09-23, so the days 19 to 23 September (5 days) are ours, we were slow because of a count difference on two pallets. But on 2026-09-23 at 17:42 we asked the Nordline ops desk to collect the empty. They only confirmed a pickup booking (BK-77120) on 2026-09-28 and collected on 09-29. So 24 to 28 September (5 days) are caused by Nordline. The 29th is the pickup day, which I accept. Timeline attached. I will send this to Pia and ask for a credit for 5 days.

emails.body: Thanks Sofie, and thanks for the clear timeline, it made this easy. Nordline agreed on the credit, so I will release INV-48213 as soon as credit note CN-20931 arrives and pay the net EUR 900 before the due date of 2026-11-07. Nothing else needed from you.

Hi Pia, we do not agree with the full amount on INV-48213. Our empty release request for MSKU1234567 went to your ops desk on 2026-09-23 at 17:42, but the pickup booking BK-77120 was only confirmed on 2026-09-28 and the container left on 09-29. That means 5 of the 11 days (24 to 28 September) were caused by the late booking on your side. We accept the other 6 days. Please issue a credit note for 5 days x EUR 150 = EUR 750. Timeline attached.

Hi Sofie, sorry for the slow answer, I checked with our ops desk. They confirm they received your request on 09-23, but after 17:00, so it was only processed on 09-24, and the terminal had no pickup slots until 09-28. From our side only 3 days are on us, so I can offer a credit of EUR 450 and you pay 8 days (EUR 1,200). Can you live with that?

Pia, I cannot accept that. Annex 2 of our transport agreement says same-day requests are accepted until 18:00, and ours came at 17:42. Also, your own confirmation mail for BK-77120 says that slots were unavailable until 09-28, so the delay was not caused by us. Even if processing started on 09-24, the 5 days from 24 to 28 September are on your side. I stay with the credit of EUR 750 and we pay 6 days, EUR 900.

Sofie, you are right about the 18:00 cut-off in Annex 2, I missed that. We agree: 5 days are on Nordline. Credit note CN-20931 for EUR 750 will be issued this week, so you pay 6 days, EUR 900 net on INV-48213. Ana, please wait for the credit note before paying. Sorry for the trouble.

facts.text: Nordline invoice INV-48213 charges EUR 1,650 detention for container MSKU1234567 at the Antwerp DC.
The charge is 11 chargeable days (19 to 29 September 2026) at EUR 150 per day; free time ended on 2026-09-18.
The due date of INV-48213 is 2026-11-07 (30 day payment term).
Ana Novak put a payment block on INV-48213 in MIR4 and asked Sofie for the unloading and pickup dates by 2026-10-16.
Unloading of MSKU1234567 finished on 2026-09-23; the 5 days from 19 to 23 September were Corp Europe's own delay because of a count difference on two pallets.
Sofie sent the empty release request to the Nordline ops desk on 2026-09-23 at 17:42.
Nordline confirmed pickup booking BK-77120 only on 2026-09-28 and collected the empty on 2026-09-29.
The 5 days from 24 to 28 September were caused by Nordline's late pickup booking.
Nordline first offered a credit of EUR 450 (3 days), arguing the request came after 17:00 and the terminal had no slots until 09-28.
Sofie rejected the offer because Annex 2 of the transport agreement accepts same-day requests until 18:00, and Nordline's own BK-77120 confirmation said slots were unavailable until 09-28.
Pia Lindqvist agreed on 2026-10-26 to a credit note CN-20931 of EUR 750 (5 days), so Corp Europe pays 6 days, EUR 900.
Ana Novak will release INV-48213 after CN-20931 arrives and pay the net EUR 900 before 2026-11-07.
